example.title: Chicken Creek Bridge (NRHP 90000298)
example.place: near Lone Star, Douglas County, KS

brief: Single stone arch of 1913 built by two local builders of local limestone on a country road: a semicircular arch of dressed voussoirs in squared, coursed limestone walls with a low solid parapet and coping, straight wing walls, and a wooden/steel rail on top on one side. Grassy, overgrown creek banks with trees; only two photos available.
